purpose: Operate and troubleshoot docker instances deployed with the OneClickVirt scripts.
notes: Read the platform precheck and installation pages before changing a host.
Use the existing host runtime and its credentials. Instance IDs and names remain the native runtime identifiers.
MCP starts read-only. Set ONECLICKVIRT_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE=1 on the intended host to expose start, graceful stop and restart; deletion, reinstall and arbitrary shell commands are not exposed.
The adapter uses the configured Docker context. Inspecting containers never returns Config.Env secrets.
purpose_zh: 管理和排查 OneClickVirt Docker 容器及宿主机环境。
notes_zh: 变更宿主机前，先阅读平台准备和安装页。
使用本机已有运行环境及凭据；实例名称和 ID 保持原运行环境的标识。
MCP 默认只读。在目标主机设置 ONECLICKVIRT_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE=1 后才提供启动、正常关机和重启；不提供删除、重装或任意 Shell 执行。
使用当前 Docker context，查询结果不返回容器 Config.Env 中的敏感变量。
